name: Joshua Bobb Piesta
title: Penetration Tester & Security Enthusiast
tagline: I find the holes before attackers do. Ex-SOC analyst turned pentester, still learning every day.
bio: I'm a Penetration Tester at UnitedHealth Group, where I run manual tests against web applications, APIs and mobile apps to find and exploit vulnerabilities before real attackers do. Before moving to the offensive side I spent two years as a SOC analyst, triaging alerts and hunting threats in Splunk and KQL, so I know what an attack looks like from both ends of the wire.

That blue-team background shapes how I test. I don't just report a finding, I explain its real-world impact and hand over a fix that actually works. My goal is to turn vulnerabilities into fortified strengths and leave every environment more secure than I found it.
I never stop learning. The certifications below are the proof, and the list keeps growing.
funFacts: I started on the blue team and switched to red. Now I know what both sides are thinking.
I read vulnerability write-ups the way other people read the news.
Favourite finding: the one the dev swore was impossible.
Yes, I have tried `sudo hire me` on my own site.

seo.description: Portfolio of Joshua Bobb Piesta, Penetration Tester and former SOC analyst. Web, API and mobile application security testing, certifications and projects.
